Hi Oliver — Rishi here (security team). Quick answers and what we can provide: 

- Pen test: We run annual third-party penetration tests (most recent completed Nov 2025) and ad-hoc vendor assessments for major infra changes. We can provide a redacted pen test report; sensitive details (exploit PoCs, exact IPs) are redacted per policy. See attached redaction policy.
- SOC 2: We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report (we typically require a DPA/NDA for full PDFs; summary docs are shareable).
- Scanning cadence: authenticated weekly vulnerability scans (internal/external), quarterly full external scans, and automated SCA on every release.
- Vulnerability SLAs (target time-to-remediate after verification): Critical = 7 days, High = 30 days, Medium = 90 days, Low = next quarterly cycle. We also have a staged disclosure process: triage → vendor notification → mitigation plan → public disclosure only after coordinated remediation.

Deliverables we can provide now:
1) Completed vendor questionnaire (we’ll fill and return to procurement).
2) Redacted SOC2 Type II (PDF summary attached) + redacted pen test report (secure link / Docusign to follow once DPA/NDA requirement is confirmed).
3) Vulnerability management playbook (attaching summary).

If you prefer, I can set up a 30-min technical sync next week to walk through the questionnaire and remediation timelines. What times work for you?

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Attachment: vuln_management_playbook.pdf (PDF)
